description: Set, change or clear the one optional email address Gate notifies when this project nears its free-plan limits (80% of its monthly calls, or its active-app limit), once per calendar month. Owner admin key only, not a team member key. Gate will email this address only about this project's usage limits, and you can clear it any time by sending alert_email: null, or with the unsubscribe link in any alert email. Never required for setup or signup.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

alert_email.description: The address to notify, or null to clear it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_set_usage_alert_email
title: Set a usage alert email
